info.title: OEC Registry – HTTP interface
info.description: The HTTP interface of the OEC Registry D5 (ADR-0029 §7, increment 3, C-088): its directory of the assets on the Message Bus (REQ-REG-001), their MAM, Health, Profile, PublicationList and SubscriptionList, the observed Messaging level and the schema conformity (informative), the Event trail and the last value of every Data DataSet (the data logger); as REST and as server-sent events. The directory is read-only: its resources take `GET` only, every other method is answered with 405 and `Allow`. Since C-113 (ADR-0035) every resource but the Web UI, the API documents, login and logout needs the session of a user: log in with `POST /api/login` and send the token as `Authorization: Bearer` or the session cookie (`__Host-oec_session` over TLS, `oec_session` over plain HTTP of development). A user has the role `admin` (also manages the users) or `user`; a user whose password has to be changed may only change it. Served over TLS (REQ-REG-007) on port 5798 (with the Web UI) and 5799 (the API only). The MG payloads are embedded as received on the bus and described by the strict D1 schemas, referenced by their $id; the payload of a participant that violates its schema may deviate (see `violations` and `conformity`).

get.description: Every asset the registry knows, applications and devices, with the limits of the directory.

parameters.name: il
parameters.description: The IdentificationLink of the asset, percent-encoded as one path segment (`vendor.com%2FPump%2FP-1%2F0815`); the plain form with `/` is accepted too.

get.description: The last Events on the bus, oldest first.

The last value of every Data DataSet on the bus (MG 9.1.4), by Source, Filter and publisher; in memory only, no history. At most `max` DataSets are kept; beyond, the one updated longest ago is dropped.

A stream of server-sent events: first a `snapshot`, then a message per change (`asset`, `event`, `directory`). A comment `: keep-alive` is sent after 15 s without a change. A client that does not read is disconnected.
The OpenAPI document of the HTTP side.
The AsyncAPI document of the MQTT interface of the registry.

post.description: A new session for a name and password. 5 wrong passwords from a client address block it for 60 s (429).

200.description: The user and the token of the session; the session cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: The session cookie (`HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/`, over TLS also `Secure`).

post.description: Ends the session of the request, if any, and clears the cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: The session cookie (`HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/`, over TLS also `Secure`).

get.description: The user of the session (also one whose password has to be changed).

post.description: Ends the other sessions of the user. A wrong current password is answered with 403 and counts as a failed login.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the user, percent-encoded.

delete.description: Ends the sessions of the user.

Error.description: The body of every error response the registry writes (hyper's own 400/431 for an unreadable request head have no body).

Limits.description: The limits of the directory: `healthHistory`, `eventTrail` and `violationTrail` from the Config `registry`/`directory` (A-393), the others fixed (C-113).

entries.description: Assets kept at most, and participants in the conformity view (fixed). When full, the offline asset seen longest ago gives way; an online or listed one never does: then a new asset is ignored.

valueMax.description: The longest MAM, Health, Profile, Event or PublicationList/SubscriptionList entry kept, octets of its JSON text (fixed); a longer one is ignored.

listEntries.description: PublicationList and SubscriptionList entries kept over all applications (fixed); beyond, a new one is ignored.

DirectoryFields.description: The directory as a whole (without its assets).

version.description: The software version of the registry.

ignored.description: Messages ignored since the start: not parseable or not of the expected form, about an asset that is not the publisher's, longer than `valueMax`, or beyond `entries` or `listEntries`.

Observed.description: The Messaging level observed on the bus (informative, ADR-0029 §5).

missing.description: The requirements of the next level not observed (empty at 3).

Conformity.description: The messages of an application checked against the strict D1 schemas (informative, A-394).

SummaryFields.description: An asset of the directory: an application (its AppId) or a device it represents.

serviceType.description: The ServiceType of the application (of the publishing application for a device).

publisher.description: The AppId that published the asset.

availability.description: From the lifecycle of MG 6.3 (an application) or of its publishing application (a device).

available.description: Available (MG A1): online with MAM and Health known.

firstSeen.description: Unix time (ms) the registry saw it first.

lastSeen.description: Unix time (ms) of its last message.

devices.description: The devices an application represents (empty for a device).

Answer.description: The outcome of the last read-only Get of the registry for a resource.

Violation.description: A message that violates its D1 schema.

Asset.description: An asset in detail: its summary, Health history, Profile, the answers to the Gets of the registry, PublicationList, SubscriptionList and schema violations (the last three `null` for a device).

healthHistory.description: The changes of its Health (state or score), oldest first, without `Details` (C-113).

seq.description: Its number since the start of the registry (ascending).

anyOf.description: The Filter of the topic (the category).

DataRecord.description: The last value of one Data DataSet.

seq.description: The number of its last update since the start of the registry (over all DataSets).

source.description: The Source of the DataSetMessage (its DataSetWriterName).

anyOf.description: The Filter of the topic, else the WriterGroupName: the DataSet.
The Payload of the last DataSetMessage, as received (MG 9.1.4).
The Payload is longer than 16 KiB (JSON text) and not kept.

SnapshotMessage.description: The first message: the directory (as `/api/assets`) and the Events (as `/api/events`).

DirectoryMessage.description: The limits or the count of ignored messages changed.

AssetMessage.description: An asset is new or its summary changed.

EventMessage.description: A new Event of the trail.

StreamMessage.description: The JSON in the `data` of a server-sent event.

ServerSentEvent.description: One server-sent event: only `data`, one line of JSON. Comments (`: keep-alive`) when the stream is quiet are not events.

mustChange.description: The password has to be changed (`POST /api/password`) before any other resource can be used.

LoggedIn.description: The user of the new session and its token.

UserCreate.description: The user has to change the password at the first login.

UserUpdate.description: A new password ends the sessions of the user, who has to change it at the next login.

BadRequest.description: Not exactly one `Host`, an absolute target that names another host, or an invalid or repeated `Content-Length`.

Forbidden.description: `Host` is no name of the registry, or `Origin` is not the registry itself; or the session may not use the resource (its password has to be changed first, or it is for admins only).

MethodNotAllowed.description: A method the resource does not take.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Too many connections (16) or event streams (8), or no place to check a password within 5 s.

Unauthorized.description: No session: no token, or its session ended. Log in with `POST /api/login`.

BadBody.description: A request head as for every resource (see `BadRequest`), or the body is not a JSON object of the members of the resource (strings), or a value is invalid (name, role, password policy: 12 … 256 characters, not the name).

RequestTimeout.description: The body did not arrive within 5 s.

BodyTooLarge.description: `Content-Length` above 65536, or a body above 4096 octets.

Conflict.description: The user exists, there are 64 users already, the last admin would be deleted or lose its role, or the password changed meanwhile.

TooManyRequests.description: 5 wrong passwords from this client address: no check for 60 s.

StoreFailed.description: The users cannot be stored (see the log of the registry).

session.name: __Host-oec_session
session.description: The session cookie of `POST /api/login` (over plain HTTP of development: `oec_session`). `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict`; the server ends the session after 30 min without a request (an open event stream counts), 12 h after the login, at logout, when the user is deleted or an admin sets its password.

bearer.description: The token of `POST /api/login` (64 hexadecimal digits), the same session as the cookie.
